findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolution_source_feed · Private data: polymarket_whales, wallet_enrich, macro_surprise, tvl_concentration · Public sink: codeaudit, txintent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolution_source_feed · Private data: polymarket_whales, wallet_enrich, macro_surprise, tvl_concentration · Public sink: codeaudit, txintent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
